mostWorthwhile.text: Making first rain and gathering it into an ocean was a clear, satisfying progression; the explanation that rain filled existing hollows rather than excavating ocean basins was especially useful.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting Lunar rhythm and Stone crust yielded no available combinations, making the search for the shore briefly feel stalled.

surprise.text: Tides needed the Moon again to become Lunar rhythm, which had no available combinations; I expected it to lead directly toward the shore.

arbitrary.text: The extra Moon combination producing Lunar rhythm felt unclear in purpose, particularly because it did not lead onward.

continue.text: Yes. The converging moon and ocean sequences and their scientifically qualified explanations make me curious about how this world will develop further, despite the brief dead end.
